firstAha: combined licensed pharmacies per km² of up to three densest แขวง/ตำบล (≥ 30 rows) of the leading province, against that province (its rows ÷ its km²), plus the densest eligible area outside it; computed per selection; the map opens in the 3D city preset with those areas focused automatically and the rest quiet
countingUnit: default: licensed rows (one ขย1 licence = one premises, unique numbers); optional every row (“รายการ”, may repeat a storefront) — the words follow the unit everywhere

accessibility: visible focus on every control including pins, area labels and chart marks
keyboard pin tour (arrow keys) at detail zoom, excluding quiet context dots
roving tablist for the chart views
table equivalent for every map view

empty, map-failure, frame-failure and load-error paths with actions

layoutContract.chartTray: collapsible bottom overlay, 52 px collapsed, 360 px / ≤58% open
layoutContract.mobilePortrait: full map, five toolbar buttons in one row (วิธีใช้ and Product statement at the top of the sheet), bottom sheet ≤ 64dvh with sticky close, compact Aha card on the map while the sheet is closed, only focus labels on the map

mapContract.basemap: generated at runtime by js/map-style.js on https://tiles.openfreemap.org/planet with --basemap-* tokens; no hosted style URL
mapContract.choropleth: density.area, five geometric 1–2–5 classes over (0, observed max], [lower, upper) with the last closed (its top printed like a density value); opacity 1 beneath the basemap's first line layer; zoom 8–14.5, the selected จังหวัด from zoom 4 (province view); EVID-05 measured / measured_zero (lowest class + 2 px zero outline); no_data treatment kept but unused (the register covers the country)
mapContract.provinces: count family per province frame below zoom 8 without a จังหวัด filter, outlines to zoom 12, ink-chip labels to zoom 9, panel list; drill-down into the จังหวัด filter, which fits the whole province and draws its แขวง/ตำบล at every zoom (no count fill under it)
mapContract.frames: data/area-index.json (every area, no geometry) + data/frames/{CODE}.json per province, loaded for the selection and for ≤ 6 provinces under the map at subdistrict zoom
mapContract.symbols: focus rows with a published point as cue icons (series fill + shape, marker-stroke outline) in a symbol layer, never clustered; context rows as grey circles; HTML pins from zoom 15.5 (≤ 320 pins); no logos
mapContract.buildings: published points × focus-tier OSM footprints (display-time join); the open building, or the building of the open store, in map.activeLayer; rounded focus massing from zoom 12 in 3D when every focus tile (≤ 16, nearest the camera) is loaded, else from 13
mapContract.labels: ink chips for the focus/selection from zoom 8 (from 4 in the province view), light chips for the rest from zoom 11 (≤ 12 desktop, none on a phone in focus mode); swatch = the area's class colour; value = ร้าน/ตร.กม.
mapContract.breadcrumb: ประเทศไทย › จังหวัด › เขต/อำเภอ › แขวง/ตำบล with production codes and /D/ /S/ deep links (no dataset parameter); store is the heading

chartContract.density: sorted bars, density class colour, value beside the bar, province under the name nationally; count bars when no area reaches the eligibility threshold
chartContract.matrix: table-layout fixed with a colgroup; every cell the same size; cell tint = count class; column headers carry the series cue
chartContract.quality: part-of-whole bar of the area's rows on the Pharmacy Council quality list (series 10 + plus cue), listed/total beside it

copy: short natural Thai: ร้านยา / ร้าน / รายการ / เครือร้าน / ร้านยาคุณภาพ / แขวง·ตำบล / เขต·อำเภอ; units on every number; provenance line (dataset · source · date · boundary · what one unit is) at the end of every panel view
